## What changed and why?

Describe the smallest useful change. Link the related issue or public source when applicable; a trivial documentation fix does not need a prior issue.

## Evidence and verification

List the focused command you ran and its result. For documentation-only changes, say that no code test was needed.

For a text contribution, link the agreed work issue and provide the candidate, retained-source locators/hashes, source manifest and implementations, independent checks, reproduction commands, visual-review evidence, source credits and unresolved questions described in `docs/TEXT_CONTRIBUTIONS.md`. Identify any incomplete scope.

## Data boundary

Does this change generated data, accepted text, source evidence, metadata, or rights? If yes, name the responsible source or authority and how the output was regenerated. If no, say `No`.
